title: Genre Specialization Registry
description: Master catalog of genre specializations known to the SGDK framework. A specialization is opt-in for a project only when declared in doc/genre_specialization_manifest.json. Promotion tiers: LABORATORIO -> TEORICA_STANDARD -> TEORICA_PRIORITARIA -> MESTRE_STANDARD -> MESTRE_PRIORITARIA. Reaching any MESTRE_* tier requires human curation plus a shipped project with ROM evidence (BlastEm), doc/10-memory-bank.md and validator output. The registry is human-curated; no auto-promotion. v2 expands the catalog to 8 families (fighting, rpg, strategy, horror, brawler, fps, platformer_puzzle, racing_sports_adventure) and three status dimensions: active (MD-feasible + opt-in ready), deferred (future_knowledge, MD-feasible but pending curadoria), deferred with mega_drive_feasible=false (future_architetural, MD-not-feasible, listed for taxonomic proficiency only).

owner_skill.description: Top-level owner skill path (fighting-game-design in v1). Per-spec owner_skill overrides this for that spec.

promotion_required_artifacts.description: Top-level shared artifact paths or role names required to justify promotion of any spec to MESTRE_*. Per-spec required files (design contract schema, validator, role data) are listed in the spec's design_contract_schema field and owner_skill path.

forbidden_inferences.description: Inference rules that must NEVER trigger activation: project folder name, code keyword regex, file extension, project short name, GDD keyword, TDD keyword. Activation is human-declared only via doc/genre_specialization_manifest.json.

families.description: Human-readable description of each genre family. Keys are family ids; values are short summaries.

mega_drive_feasibility_legend.description: Legend explaining how status + mega_drive_feasible interact.

owner_skill.description: Path to the orchestrator skill that owns this specialization. For multi-family support, multiple specs share a family-level skill (e.g., rpg-game-design owns all RPG specs).

design_contract_schema.description: Path to the design contract schema (relative to tools/sgdk_wrapper/schemas/) that the project must instantiate. For future_architetural specs without a contract, use a family placeholder like 'rpg_design_contract.schema.json' to indicate the family design surface even if no validator exists yet.

frozen_design_axes.description: Axes whose values are policy-locked. TDD/validator must enforce them.

advisory_design_axes.description: Axes whose values are guidance only, not gateable.

phase_aware_blockers.description: Blockers that only fire in ready_for_aaa or closeout tiers. vertical_slice is never blocked by these.
